name: uiux-ai-workspace
tagline_zh: 做界面最烦的不是画不出，是每次都要重新想流程：竞品怎么拆、设计系统怎么起、交付给前端怎么标。
tagline_en: The hard part of UI/UX isn't drawing — it's re-deciding the process every time. 99 skills, one per stage.
why_zh: 按设计流程的阶段切分，而不是按工具切分。所以你能只装「竞品拆解」那一格，不被迫吞下整套方法论。
why_en: Split by design-workflow stage, not by tool. So you can install just the competitive-teardown slot without swallowing a whole.
limit_zh: 99 个技能是并列清单，不是一条自动流水线：装完不会自己串起来跑，得你自己按阶段挑、按顺序调。
limit_en: The 99 skills are a flat list, not an auto pipeline — you pick and sequence them yourself. Covers UI/UX process and deliverable specs only; it.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 99 UI/UX skills, from teardown to handoff in one pack
